birth_rate_fertility/both.root_label: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects (WPP)

cirrhosis_alcohol_mortality/both.root_label: WHO Mortality Database (civil registration, as submitted by member states)

hiv_prevalence_rate/both.root_label: UNAIDS (the Global AIDS Update epidemic indicators, modeled estimates; via OWID's chart door)

homicide_rate/both.root_label: UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)

industrial_employment_share/both.root_label: ILO modelled estimates, ILOSTAT 2EMP family (redistributed by World Bank WDI as the employment-by-sector share codes)

infant_mortality/both.root_label: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (IGME)

life_expectancy/female.root_label: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects (WPP)

life_expectancy/male.root_label: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects (WPP)

life_expectancy_60/female.root_label: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects (WPP)

life_expectancy_60/male.root_label: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects (WPP)

maternal_mortality_ratio/both.root_label: UN Maternal Mortality Estimation Inter-agency Group (MMEIG)

math_test_scores/both.root_label: OECD PISA assessment (the PISA Database mean scale scores; via OWID's chart door)

obesity_rate/both.root_label: NCD Risk Factor Collaboration, adult BMI pooled analysis (republished by WHO GHO as the NCD_BMI_* family)

secondary_education_share/both.root_label: Eurostat labour-force statistics (une_rt_a — national official unemployment rates collected by Eurostat)

suicide_rate/both.root_label: WHO Global Health Estimates (GHE) — modeled cause-of-death estimates

tertiary_education_share/both.root_label: Eurostat labour-force statistics (une_rt_a — national official unemployment rates collected by Eurostat)

top_income_share/both.root_label: World Inequality Database (WID.world — DINA research harmonization, pre-tax national income concepts; via OWID's chart door)

unemployment_rate/both.root_label: ILOSTAT LFS database (ILO-processed national labour-force surveys; class-decomposition rate flows on the ILO's own SDMX wire, redistributed by World Bank WDI as national estimate)
